sentences.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Emili. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. In this podcast,
we speak slow and easy English. Today, we talk about a beautiful and historical city.
The city is Prisran. Prisran is in Kosovo. Kosovo is a country in Southeast Europe. Prisran
is one of the oldest and most beautiful cities in the country. Part 2. Prisran is located near
mountains. The city has a river called the Lombardi River. The river goes through the city center.
This makes the city very peaceful and beautiful. Part 3. Prisran has a long history. Many different
cultures lived here in the past. Because of this, the city has a mix of traditions. You can see
different influences in architecture and culture. Part 4. One famous place in Prisran is the Old
Stone Bridge. This bridge is in the city center. People walk across it every day. It is a symbol
of the city. Part 5. Another important place is Prisran Fortress. It is on a hill above the city.
From the fortress, you can see all of Prisran. The view is very beautiful, especially at sunset.
Part 6. The Old Town of Prisran is very charming. There are narrow streets and old houses. People
walk, shop, and drink coffee in small cafes. The atmosphere is calm and friendly. Part 7.
Prisran has many mosques and churches. This shows the cultural diversity of the city.
Different communities live together in peace. This is an important part of Prisran's identity.
Part 8. Food in Prisran is delicious and traditional. People eat grilled meat, bread, and vegetables. One
popular food is called burek. It is a pastry filled with meat or cheese. Part 9. The people of Prisran
are friendly and welcoming. Visitors often feel safe and comfortable. Hospitality is very important
in daily life. People like to share food and tea with guests. Part 10. The weather in Prisran is
warm in summer. Winters can be cold and snowy. Spring is green and beautiful. Many visitors come
in spring and summer. Part 11. Prisran also has festivals. One famous event is Dokufest.
It is a film festival. People from many countries come to watch films and enjoy the city. Part 12.
Prisran is a beautiful city full of history, culture, and nature. The river, fortress,
and old streets make it special. Visitors can enjoy peace, tradition, and friendly people.
Even though it is not very big, Prisran is a wonderful place to discover.
